_note: Specification-level flow definition, not a pac-exported artifact — no tenant to build this in yet (docs/09-build-report.md).
description: Safety net for F1: catches any eng_transactionline that never got processed (F1 crashed, was throttled, or the org hit an API limit) and replays F1's logic against it.

trigger.detail: button, for an admin to force a sweep immediately after a known incident

actions.name: Find_stuck_lines
actions.detail: eng_transactionline where eng_processed = false AND createdon < now-15min, ordered by createdon ascending (oldest first — preserves per-asset ordering, FR-015/FR-019).
actions.note: The 15-minute grace window avoids racing a line F1 is still legitimately in the middle of.

actions.name: Reprocess
actions.detail: Calls F1's logic directly (not a re-trigger of the Dataverse event) for each line, in order.

actions.name: Report
actions.detail: Count of lines found and reprocessed, so a recurring problem is visible even if every individual retry eventually succeeds.
